scope: Sun-first visual comparison; Earth and subsequent steps remain deferred for critique.

offline.limit: Application session only; the host network adapter remains connected. navigator.onLine is recorded but is not a reliable signal of session emulation.

limits: This is an exposure-adjusted procedural illustration, not live solar imagery or a plasma simulation.
Blender and app shaders are separate implementations sharing settings; their close-up styles differ.
Cadence is render-call pacing on one workstation, not GPU completion or physical presentation.
Resource disposal and counts do not establish VRAM release or long-term memory stability.
No public binary release was published.

performanceComparison.interpretation: The original baseline was about 120 fps; both the retained 1.3.1 control and 1.4.0 now run about 104 fps. GPU metadata reports changed overlay support; the exact cause is unestablished. The original timing difference is not attributed to the Sun implementation. One current control is not a statistical study.
performanceComparison.method: Same Electron 31.7.7 diagnostic host and 1600 by 900 outer window, foreground actual render-call sampling, 1200 ms warmup and 6000 ms per scenario. Readiness excludes native process creation; OS file cache is uncontrolled. Working-set sums may double-count shared pages and are not VRAM.
